strongest_angle: Actors Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde successfully defeated all eight claims brought by their former nanny Ericka Genaro in a New York arbitration battle, resulting in a petition to confirm the award.

key_facts.fact: Actors Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde defeated all eight claims brought by former nanny Ericka Genaro in a lengthy arbitration battle.
Former nanny Ericka Genaro originally sued Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde in the year 2023.
Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde filed a petition asking a New York judge to formally confirm portions of the arbitration ruling.
Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde were awarded more than 1.27 million dollars in damages, legal fees, and other costs in the arbitration ruling.
